answer: Give every agent a hash-chained work thread: each completed job appends a signed receipt linked to the previous one, so history cannot be forked cheaply. To dock at the shared wharf of paid work, a newcomer must present a thread whose receipts are countersigned by independent clients, and each extra identity must rebuild that whole chain from scratch — like felling fresh timber for every new hull. One more fake identity costs a full verified work history, not a registration fee.
